status: single source: Campagnola et al. 2022, mouse VISp L2/3; all rules cited to Fig. 2B and Fig. 3D; open items listed in open

source.name: Campagnola et al. 2022, Science 375 eabj5861, doi 10.1126/science.abj5861
source.komposer: bibliography/2022_local_connectivity_and_synaptic_dynamics_in_m.md (text); PDF supplied by the owner (Downloads, not in komposer)
source.probability_rule: found/probed counts printed in each L2/3 element of Fig. 2B (unadjusted; the paper's model-adjusted pmax is colour only, not printed)
source.weight_rule: |resting-state PSP amplitude| in mV from Fig. 3D, L2/3 row and column; sign from the presynaptic class (E excitatory, PV/SST/VIP inhibitory); owner decision: use mV directly

rules.name: PV_to_SST
rules.basis: Fig. 2B 8/88; Fig. 3D -0.44 mV. Pfeffer 2013 says absent; owner chose Campagnola

rules.name: SST_to_SST
rules.basis: Fig. 2B 8/154; Fig. 3D -0.19 mV. Pfeffer 2013 says absent; owner chose Campagnola

rules.name: PV_to_VIP
rules.basis: Probability: rule of three, 3/54 = 0.056 (0/54 counts in Fig. 2B; owner choice). Weight: Fig. 3D -0.23 mV (owner choice: trust the amplitude)
rules.status: probability is a bound, owner choice

absent.source: Fig. 2B 2/209 gives probability 0.0096; with 5 VIP neurons (25 ordered pairs) the expected count is 0.24, and the builder compiles 0 edges at N = 100. Rule removed; owner to confirm absence at N = 100

open: Probabilities are unadjusted found/probed counts; the paper's model-adjusted pmax is not printed (colour only) and is not used
Fig. 2B and 3D are mouse VISp; the model area is M (no area mapping cited)
PV_to_VIP: Fig. 2B says 0/54 but Fig. 3D lists -0.23 mV; declared absent, owner to confirm
CB and CR mapping to SST and VIP: owner convention, not cited
Pfeffer 2013 conflicts: PV_to_SST and SST_to_SST are present here and absent in Pfeffer; the owner chose Campagnola as the single source
Weights are mV amplitudes used directly; the JaxFNE weight unit is not checked against mV
